cells.label: fact
cells.reason: Multiple passages across firms and research sources state specific AI and digital tools and capabilities advisors use or will use to deliver advice.

items.text: Deloitte research states that Morgan Stanley's AI Debrief automatically summarizes meetings, generates follow-ups, and logs notes into the CRM, freeing advisers to spend more time on client conversations.
items.quote: Morgan Stanley's AI Debrief, for example, automatically summarizes meetings, generates follow-ups, and logs notes into the customer relationship management system, reducing manual documentation and freeing advisers to spend more time on client conversations rather than administrative tasks.

items.text: Deloitte research states Altruist's Hazel AI can analyze tax returns and portfolio data to generate tax-planning insights and scenarios in seconds.
items.quote: Emerging platforms such as Altruist's Hazel AI—which can analyze tax returns and portfolio data to generate tax-planning insights and scenarios in seconds—illustrate how AI can handle complex analytical tasks that previously required hours of manual work.

items.text: Deloitte research states advisers will increasingly operate with a team of digital agents, supervising AI systems that handle preparation, monitoring, and routine servicing.
items.quote: In this environment, advisers increasingly operate with a team of digital agents, supervising AI systems that handle preparation, monitoring, and routine servicing.

items.text: Deloitte research states that as firms advance, copilots are embedded in workflows and governance frameworks allow bounded delegation.
items.quote: As firms move into the expanding stage, where copilots are embedded in workflows and governance frameworks allow bounded delegation, productivity uplift rises to about 57%.

items.text: Raymond James's investor day deck lists an 'AI 360' set of capabilities for advisors, including prudent process reviews, meeting and CRM notes management, client portfolio analyses, opportunity dashboard, research and news summaries, statement scanning, regulatory feed summarization, expert service agents, and podcast reviews.
items.quote: AI 360 / Prudent Process Reviews / Meeting & CRM Notes Management / Client Portfolio Analyses / Opportunity Dashboard / Research & News Summaries / Statement Scanning / Regulatory Feed Summarization / Expert Service Agents / Podcast Reviews

items.text: Capgemini research states Standard Chartered Bank's MyWealth advisor solution provides relationship managers a consolidated view of client holdings and risk profiles and generates portfolio insights and investment ideas.
items.quote: MyWealth advisor provides RMs with a consolidated view of client holdings and risk profiles, and generates portfolio insights and investment ideas based on current portfolio positions, client risk appetite, and alignment with house and product views.

items.text: McKinsey research states gen AI can synthesize information to prepare advisors for client meetings and automate the development of financial plans and proposals.
items.quote: Preparing for client meetings. GenAI can rapidly synthesize information from various sources and prepare advisors for meetings with an overview of a client's portfolio... Creating financial plans and proposals. Advanced analytics techniques... combined with gen AI, can automate the development of financial plans

items.text: Osaic CEO Jamie Price described a 'plug and play' ecosystem for advisors to select from tools such as Jump, Zocks, GReminders, Vanilla, and Redtail CRM.
items.quote: CEO Jamie Price described a "plug and play" ecosystem for advisors across the Osaic network, where they can select from tools such as Jump, Zocks, GReminders, Vanilla, and Redtail CRM, combining as they best see fit.

items.text: Nevis CEO Mark Swan said advisors will have hundreds of agents supporting them, including agents that build wealth and estate plans, file taxes, open custody accounts, and move money.
items.quote: I think advisors will have literally hundreds of agents supporting them with a broad range of services to clients. You will have agents that build wealth and estate plans, agents that will file taxes on behalf of clients. You will have agents that are opening custody accounts and moving money.

items.text: Schwab's Claude for Financial Advisors gives RIAs AI connectors between Schwab Advisor Center and their own tools to automate research, meeting preparation, and documentation tasks.
items.quote: gives RIAs that custody with Schwab the option to pay for a suite of AI connectors between the Schwab Advisor Center and their own tools to help automate research, meeting preparation and documentation tasks.

items.text: Schwab's advisor center offers access to Wealth.com's Ester, an AI-powered tax and estate planning tool.
items.quote: Schwab announced that its advisor center would offer access to Wealth.com's Ester, an artificial intelligence-powered tax and estate planning tool.

items.text: Morgan Stanley CFO Sharon Yeshaya described early AI use cases including DevGen AI (developer code modernization), Parable (analyzes and summarizes data), and LeadIQ (AI-powered lead distribution platform).
items.quote: These include the DevGen AI tool, which enhances developer efficiency by modernizing code, Parable, an interactive tool that quickly analyzes and summarizes data, and LeadIQ, our AI-powered lead distribution platform, focusing on matching workplace and self-directed relationships and facilitating engagement with our financial advisors.

items.text: Schwab executives indicated AI agent access will eventually expand beyond read-only to taking action on client accounts and advisor workflows (bidirectional).
items.quote: Maybe next year we'll be talking about bidirectional... AI agents that could not only read data from Schwab but also act on accounts... The aspiration for all of us is as we get more confident and more secure in what we're doing to make the interactions bidirectional.

items.text: Schwab CEO Rick Wurster said the firm is rolling out an AI-powered thinkorswim assistant and piloting a connection to its MCP layer via an LLM.
items.quote: we are rolling out an AI-powered thinkorswim assistant and have started a pilot for traders to safely and securely connect to our MCP layer via the LLM of their choice.

items.text: Bank of America CEO Brian Moynihan said AI tools are designed to help customer relationship managers prepare more thoroughly for client meetings, and bankers automate research and presentation materials.
items.quote: These tools are designed to help our customer relationship managers prepare more thoroughly for the client meetings. Our bankers automate the research and presentation materials.

items.text: Bank of America's investor day deck lists enhanced wealth and estate planning tools and a simplified, consolidated client servicing platform.
items.quote: Enhanced wealth & estate planning tools / Simplified and consolidated client servicing platform

items.text: Raymond James CEO Paul Shoukry referenced launching the firm's AI operations agent, Rai, and automating processes.
items.quote: You spoke about automating processes and launching your AI operations agent, Rai.

items.text: Zocks, approved by LPL, prepares advisors for client meetings with personalized summaries and drafts post-meeting summaries, action items and emails, syncing across planning tools and CRMs.
items.quote: The tool also prepares advisors for client meetings with personalized summaries pulled from past conversations and connected systems and drafts post-meeting summaries, action items and emails.
